projects.title: Microcontroller pulse width modulation by analog voltage
projects.description:
•	Created an assembly program to convert analog voltage controlled by a potentiometer into a 10-bit digital value
•	Implemented a timer output compare interrupt routine to adjust the frequency according to the converted input
•	Created a serial connection with the microcontroller to enable the user to begin/stop the output frequency as well as display the analog input and frequency values

projects.title: Magnetic Sensor Controlled Static Random Access Memory
projects.description: In our electronics course, my team and I were asked to design and construct an original concept. We implemented Transistor-Transistor Logic and shift registers to create a magnetic sensor controlled static random access memory interface. The project called for PCB design to ensure flush and presentable connections through appropriate orientation of the components utilized. We also created a complete full analysis and detailed report of key current and voltage values. I presented our circuit design by using OrCAD pspice software to create a model representation highlighting component values and part numbers.
